body:
## [3.60.0] - 2026-08-06

### Features

- restore multi-currency cash counting to Open/Close register
- proportional Jewelry cart columns + move Coupon toggle to Settings
- add Fast Cash / Fast Credit quick-pay buttons to the Grocery preset

### Bug Fixes

- remove Reports Between Dates section
- allow clearing declined terminal attempts
- show the currency symbol actually assigned to each payment method
- address register lifecycle review
- simplify register refresh loading state
- disable register auth during refresh
- preserve null is_foreign_currency instead of coercing to false
- warn when register refresh blocks reopen
- await multi-currency setting instead of racing its first stream value; fix loading-state fallback for split-payment evidence
- fetch opening-register payment methods scoped to this POS on employee-login
- default-cash ordering, resilient close, POS-scoped methods, phone multi-currency
- resolve hidden cash method for base-currency change
- show native-currency amounts for foreign cash, dedupe localizer
- guard register reopen during close refresh
- refine old-schema detection for productDescriptionFlex value
- align promo/loyalty row columns with the header's flex baseline
- catch old-schema Jewelry configs within the new range, restore flex clamp, fix stale wording
- broadcast split-session changes on restore and clear too
- variant column squeeze + migrate old pixel-width layout configs
- align multicurrency settlement display
- treat allocation-only split payments as unresolved evidence too
- catch payment tenders still pending in the split dialog
- centralize multicurrency settlement
- Fast Cash/Fast Credit stay disabled only for unresolved split payments
- preserve multicurrency change retry metadata
- avoid fx rounding on currency overpayment
- keep multi-currency change with tender
- support partial phone searches
- allow customer phone search
- search displayed status labels
- limit search to visible fields
- revert Total Due gating to the Restrict Customer Account toggle
- await payment methods before skipping the Total Due fetch
- gate Total Due on pay_later availability, not the restrict toggle
- salesperson auto-assign, hide Total Due when unused, preserve QC customer on suspend
- address second-round review on Fast Cash/Fast Credit quick-pay
- address code review on real-customer preservation
- address code review on Fast Cash/Fast Credit quick-pay
- preserve real customer identity through Named Tax Invoice swaps

### Other Changes

- point submodule at multi-currency register backend (flutter_pos_api#7)
- point submodule at multi-currency register backend (flutter_pos_api#7)
- point submodule at the merged backend (flutter_pos_api#5)
- Potential fix for pull request finding
- Potential fix for pull request finding
- Potential fix for pull request finding
- report development PR validation
- reset odoo19 development to main
- use subscription-backed Codex PR reviews
- preserve backend results after Flutter failures
- checkout only the pinned Odoo addon
- add Odoo 19 private development releases
